legend.meaning: Four categorical colors. The legend supplies no numeric units or concentration-to-opacity transfer function.
legend.sample_coordinate_convention: zero-based source-legend pixel coordinates (x, y); solid swatch centers
legend.interpretation_limit: A selected pixel is a visual color match, not identification or measurement of a chemical species. Mixed or base-map colors may enter a hue window.

baseline_mask_audit.source_fingerprint_scope: Historical baseline inspected for this audit; later implementation changes must record their own algorithm version.
baseline_mask_audit.weight_definition: HSV saturation * HSV value for qualifying pixels, zero otherwise; with RGB in [0,1], this equals max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B) for qualifying pixels.
baseline_mask_audit.coverage_definition: Fraction of image pixels with positive color weight. This is not atmospheric or geographic area coverage.
limitations: Composited terrain, illumination, city lights and aerosol colors cannot be separated reliably using hue alone.
Single legend swatch checks do not validate broad hue windows or ambiguous composite pixels.
No numeric aerosol concentration or latitude can be recovered from the recorded PNG and this manifest alone.

sonification_reference.title: Data Sonification: Caldwell 73
sonification_reference.original_mapping: Rotating radar scan; star distance from center maps to pitch; the entire image becomes a choir, with orange/red stars represented by marimba and blue stars by glockenspiel.
sonification_reference.terraecho_adaptation: Left-to-right scan; color selects an original synthesized voice, visual color weight controls gain, vertical image position controls pitch. This is an adaptation, not the Caldwell algorithm or its audio.
